==Acquisition==
Temporarily, as one of the five skills available while under the effect of [[Ursan Blessing]].

==Notes==
* Ursan Roar will affect allied spirits to different degrees, similar to [[Signet of Ghostly Might]]:
** Spirits that directly attack enemies such as [[Pain]], [[Shadowsong]] or [[Anguish]] will get the damage bonus applied to their attacks. Anguish will also double the damage bonus if the target is hexed.
** Spirits that cause health loss on enemies around them, such as [[Agony]] will see no interaction whatsoever.
** Spirits that directly attack enemies but do life steal packets rather than damage packets, such as [[Vampirism]] or [[Bloodsong]] will not be affected in any way.
** [[Wanderlust]] causes its knockdown with an attack that deals zero damage, so it gets the damage bonus applied to its attacks, causing some damage.
** In case it applies, the bonus damage from Ursan Roar will stack normally with the damage reduction effect of [[Spiritleech Aura]] even if it's applied last, not allowing you to mask Spiritleech Aura's damage reduction on 0 damage attacks and then apply the bonus from Ursan Roar.
{{bug|If you control-click the [[skill icon]] in the [[effects monitor]] (when Ursan Roar is active on you) it will say "I am empowered by Ursan Roar" without any punctuation.}}
